task.title: Preserve local infrastructure and centralize cross-scope dead letters

events.content: Store cross-scope dead-letter records at the catalog root: Store cross-scope dead-letter records at the catalog root

raw.question: Store cross-scope dead-letter records at the catalog root
raw.chosen: Store cross-scope dead-letter records at the catalog root
raw.reasoning: A sibling provider's disconnect preflight cannot discover a bulk record stored only under the first child's runtime root.

events.content: Preserve mount-excluded infrastructure during scoped disconnect: Preserve mount-excluded infrastructure during scoped disconnect

raw.question: Preserve mount-excluded infrastructure during scoped disconnect
raw.chosen: Preserve mount-excluded infrastructure during scoped disconnect
raw.reasoning: Entries such as .git are intentionally outside mount synchronization and therefore cannot be deleted as mirrored provider content.

retrospective.summary: Centralized multi-root dead letters at the catalog root and preserved mount-excluded infrastructure during scoped disconnect cleanup.
